meta.title: Unofficial Tactical Guide — Leonida 100% & BuckMe Protocol
meta.disclaimer: Independent Unofficial Strategy Guide. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

story_chapters.name: Chapter 1 — Leonida Keys (Key Lento)
story_chapters.critical_alert: STOP before 'Recalibration' & 'Tourist Trap': pocket cash is already wiped when starting Recalibration, and Tourist Trap wipes Floor Stash, BuckMe Checking & your Ganado! Keep /bin/bash pocket cash (purchases under ,000 auto-pull from BuckMe), lock ,000 in Family Savings (grows to ,000), and spend spare cash on permanent guns/silencers/clothes.
key_unlocks: Cop Scanner police radio app (Unwanted Attention)
Brian's Lockup mailbox payout unlocked (Hey, Arnold!)

story_chapters.name: Chapter 2 — Port Gellhorn (Kelly County)
story_chapters.critical_alert: During Alvan West's 'Missing Tourists' chain, go SOLO to 'Return to the Trophy Room' — bringing your partner prevents the abduction and abruptly ends the mission.
key_unlocks: Free Jason ↔ Lucia switching (D-Pad Right + R1/RB) & Shared Focus (L3+R3)
Slim Jim tool & tracker-free car fencing for Moses
Personal Garages unlocked (Mitchell Auto Center — $4,000 after Daily Driver)
Bret Vogel hunting decks (after Coffee Break) & 2 AM UFO Abduction (Starlet Motel)

story_chapters.name: Chapter 3 — Vice City (Vice-Dale County)
story_chapters.critical_alert: NEVER delegate loot sales to Lucia or Nico — tested drops prove a 58% to 66% payout cut ($45k drops to $17k). Complete timed 'Race Against Yago' immediately when it spawns.
key_unlocks: Snap Gun silent lockpick (Yasmani's 3 Jewelry Jobs)
Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills (Credit Check)
Key Cloner & Randy's 22-Car VIP Wish List (Balsero)
2 Secret WAiNK Radios & 2002 Vice City PS2 Portal Easter Egg

story_chapters.name: Chapter 4 — Major Heists & Supercars
story_chapters.critical_alert: Right after 'Lawyer Up', play as Lucia near Hamlet so you don't miss the hourglass-timed 'Pick Up Shayna' side encounter.
key_unlocks: Advanced (Red) Tracker removal at Pay 'n' Spray (Shoot a Promo + '64 Mamba GT)
Gruppe 6 Armored Van tips & $205,000 Open Bank Vaults (That's Where the Money Is...)

story_chapters.name: Chapter 5 — Story Finale
story_chapters.critical_alert: Jason and Lucia have separate Criminal Profiles (5 tiers: Professional → Hardened → Violent → Psycho → Irredeemable; check via Map → L1/LB → Jason & Lucia). Never drop to Irredeemable (irreversible; blocks surrendering & alters the ending). Cap Family Savings (M–M) before the finale.
key_unlocks: Full Free-Roam with zero missable 100% requirements

family_savings_tiers.benefit: Instant +$2,000 interest bonus in Ch. 1 ($7,000 total carried into Ch. 2).
Permanent 20% discount on all RydeMe rides.
Permanent 20% discount on all 8 personal garages (saves $32,000).
Permanent 10% discount on all vehicle liveries.
Final savings milestone ($1M–$2M) tracked for the campaign ending.

fences.item: Jewelry, Diamond Rings, Necklaces & Luxury Watches
fences.delegation_loss: 58%–66% cut (NEVER delegate to Lucia or Nico)
fences.tip: Finish all 3 Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and purple daily scores up to $50k.
Requires Dye Pack Jammer. Use a van (14 duffel bags total) on the 5-Bank 25-min loop.
In Ch. 1, finish 'Hey, Arnold!' to release held Brian's Lockup funds into your mailbox.
Always scan with WAiNK first. Use Slim Jim for silent entry. Cheap registration: $1,200.
North Capri & Vespucci Island spawn high-end supercars with low security. Red trackers unlock Ch. 4.
Complete 15 sets for 100% before selling off spares.

fences.item: Underwater Treasure Sets (5 of 7 Sets for 100%)
fences.location: Key Lento Beach Shop (after Hey, Arnold!)
fences.tip: Zero police heat. If Kenton vanishes in Ch. 2, call Brian as Jason to bring him back sooner.

missables_alerts.title: Ch. 1 Meditation Spot with Lucia (Key Lento)
missables_alerts.detail: At Jason's Key Lento house, ACCEPT Lucia's meditation invite. Declining removes this spot forever (potential trophy risk for Positive Mental Attitude).

missables_alerts.title: Point of No Return: 'Recalibration' & 'Tourist Trap' Wipe
missables_alerts.detail: Pocket cash is already lost starting Recalibration, and Tourist Trap wipes Floor Stash, Checking & Ganado. Run with /bin/bash pocket cash, lock ,000 in Family Savings, and spend every spare dollar on permanent weapons/silencers/clothes.

missables_alerts.title: Shirley's Chapter 1 Timed Side Jobs
missables_alerts.detail: 'Get Shirley's Rum' (~$1,300 via parrot clue at Three Sheets Liquor) and 'Steal the Scooter' expire once you leave Chapter 1.

missables_alerts.title: Alvan West — Go SOLO to Trophy Room
missables_alerts.detail: In 'Missing Person (Return to the Trophy Room)', arrive ALONE. Bringing your partner cancels the kidnapping and abruptly ends the quest.

missables_alerts.title: Timed 'Race Against Yago' Event
missables_alerts.detail: After 'Join a Street Race' in Chapter 3, complete 'Race Against Yago' before advancing.

missables_alerts.title: 2002 Vice City Portal — Zero Fast Travel
missables_alerts.detail: After triggering Badger R&D Tower as Jason, NEVER fast travel or switch to Lucia until all 12 LPL switches are pulled (fly a helicopter!).

missables_alerts.title: Shayna Hourglass Event (Lucia Only)
missables_alerts.detail: After 'Lawyer Up' in Ch. 4, drive near Hamlet as Lucia to catch the hourglass-marked 'Pick Up Shayna' mission.

missables_alerts.title: Irreversible 'Irredeemable' Criminal Profile
missables_alerts.detail: Jason & Lucia track separate 5-tier Criminal Profiles (Map → L1/LB → Jason & Lucia). 'Irredeemable' is permanent, disables surrendering to police, and affects the story ending.

checklist_100.title: Main Story Complete
checklist_100.tip: Ch.1 (22) • Ch.2 (11) • Ch.3 (26) • Ch.4 (25) • Ch.5 (7). No mission replay at launch — rotate all 15 manual save slots!

checklist_100.title: Optional Story & Side Tasks
checklist_100.tip: Complete companion optional jobs plus the 8 eligible Strangers & Freaks chains.

checklist_100.title: Illegal Operations (Gang Ops)
checklist_100.tip: Only 19 show on the map — 20 are hidden. Loot EVERY valuable item in each hideout for credit!

checklist_100.title: Bank Robberies
checklist_100.tip: Chain the 5-Bank 25-min van route (14 bags) using office safe codes instead of explosives.

checklist_100.title: Payday Loan Jobs
checklist_100.tip: 2 jobs unlock Nico's pickup service (still deliver personally to avoid the 60% cut).

checklist_100.title: Smash 'n' Grabs (Jewelry & Pawn)
checklist_100.tip: 20 Jewelry stores ($9k–$25k) + 13 Pawn shops ($1k–$12k). Unlock the Snap Gun first!

checklist_100.title: Stick Ups (V4 Audited)
checklist_100.tip: Knock these out steadily across convenience stores outside active Hot Areas.

checklist_100.title: Bank Vaults Hit
checklist_100.tip: Late Ch. 4: tail Gruppe 6 armored vans to banks and slip into open vaults (up to $205k!).

checklist_100.title: Narcotics Fenced
checklist_100.tip: Sell directly to Tyrone (Ch. 3+) or Brian's Lockup (clear Hey, Arnold! first).

checklist_100.title: Jewelry Fenced
checklist_100.tip: Deliver personally to Yasmani in Capri — never delegate to Lucia.

checklist_100.title: Marked Bills Fenced
checklist_100.tip: V4 audited target: $250,000. Requires Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check). Three 5-bank van runs easily clear this!

checklist_100.title: Vehicles Fenced
checklist_100.tip: V4 audited target: $200,000. Moses (no tracker) + Randy Koslov (supercar farms in North Capri & Vespucci Island).

checklist_100.title: Kenton's Treasure Sets
checklist_100.tip: Starts at Key Lento beach after Hey, Arnold! Pays $50k–$200k per set with zero heat.

checklist_100.title: Collectible Card Sets
checklist_100.tip: 480 cards total across 18 sets. Run the North → South sweep to avoid backtracking.

checklist_100.title: WAiNK Landmark Scans
checklist_100.tip: Keep WAiNK phone notifications enabled (Hold D-Pad Up → R1 / RB).

checklist_100.title: Underwater Discoveries
checklist_100.tip: Sweep alongside Kenton's scuba diving questline across the Keys & southern coast.

checklist_100.title: Magazines, Books & Comics
checklist_100.tip: Check Hamlet prison, roadside bars, motels, and safehouses.

checklist_100.title: Meditation Spots
checklist_100.tip: Accept Lucia's Ch. 1 invite and always invite your partner at every spot (tracked per character).

checklist_100.title: Cocaine Flamingos Destroyed
checklist_100.tip: Black/white beak = collectible; yellow beak = decoration only!

checklist_100.title: Unique Playlists (Secret Radios)
checklist_100.tip: The Vault (1 red gas-mask poster) + The Sniper of La Perle (4 posters: TWA Tattoo, Drip Drops, Aunt Zola's, Jack of Hearts 2F).

checklist_100.title: Styles Discovered (Tattoos & Watches)
checklist_100.tip: Luxury watches spawn inside Gang Operations; scan graffiti tags for tattoos.

checklist_100.title: Unique Races Won (Post-Launch Audited)
checklist_100.tip: Audited total is 40 race locations (30 required for 100%, 20 for trophy).

checklist_100.title: Race Challenges Gold Medals
checklist_100.tip: Use an upgraded personal garage supercar at Gellhorn International Raceway.

checklist_100.title: Shooting Range Gold Medals
checklist_100.tip: Set Aim Assist to 4 and sensitivity to 5–6 for crisp 30 FPS target snaps.

checklist_100.title: Video Games / Arcade Beaten
checklist_100.tip: Beat all 4 retro arcade cabinets across Leonida.

checklist_100.title: Pool Opponents Defeated
checklist_100.tip: Found in bars across Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, and Vice City.

checklist_100.title: Mini Golf Courses Played
checklist_100.tip: V4 verified target: finish a round at 2 of the 3 Mini Golf locations in Leonida.

checklist_100.title: Basketball Hoops Scored
checklist_100.tip: Street courts across Vice City and coastal neighborhoods.

checklist_100.title: Top Fun Drone Time Trials
checklist_100.tip: Feather throttle on tight gates — flagship shops in Washington Island & Capri.

checklist_100.title: Stunts Completed
checklist_100.tip: Stack with Papa Audacity's 6-part AudaCity Stunts questline.

checklist_100.title: In-Game Challenges Completed
checklist_100.tip: Example: spending over $5,000 on clothes clears the Well Dressed challenge.

checklist_100.title: Bret's Target Decks (Hunting)
checklist_100.tip: Unlocks after Ch. 2's Coffee Break. Deliver Pristine or Good pelts/animals.

checklist_100.title: Vehicles Discovered
checklist_100.tip: V4 verified target: 200 of 277 Base Models (557 includes variants).

checklist_100.title: Weapons Discovered
checklist_100.tip: Check all 24 Ammu-Nations (5 Expanded carry Snipers/Launchers) + free map weapons.

checklist_100.title: Animals Discovered
checklist_100.tip: Scan wildlife in Mount Kalaga, Grassrivers swamps, and underwater reefs.

strangers_freaks.name: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove)
strangers_freaks.trigger: Read flyer at Skeeter's Bar (Hamlet) or Rusty Anchor (Key Lento)
strangers_freaks.reward: $1,000 initial payout + 3-part night questline (Part 3 is Lucia-only)

strangers_freaks.name: Kyle (McKittrick Farm / Red Hulk)
strangers_freaks.reward: Free chemicals (Negotiate → Pay Later → Give Collateral) + Stamina/Focus boosts + Legendary Shotgun + $10k

strangers_freaks.name: Alvan West (Missing Tourists)
strangers_freaks.trigger: Missing poster in Port Gellhorn (Ch. 2) + 3 clue photos
strangers_freaks.reward: ALERT: Go SOLO to 'Return to the Trophy Room'!

strangers_freaks.name: Yago (Street Racer)
strangers_freaks.trigger: Join a Street Race in Salton after Dealer's Choice (Ch. 3, Jason)
strangers_freaks.reward: Unlocks street races. 'Race Against Yago' is timed!

strangers_freaks.name: Papa Audacity
strangers_freaks.trigger: 6-part stunt chain (The Unknown Stuntman → The Audacity)
strangers_freaks.reward: AudaCity Stunts events & massive Stunt progress.

strangers_freaks.name: Pilot Pete
strangers_freaks.trigger: The Last Mile + 3 air drops (Pete's Deliveries)

strangers_freaks.name: Dr. Merle (No Flushers)
strangers_freaks.trigger: Scan QR poster inside Corsair Key public restroom (WAiNK)
strangers_freaks.reward: The Final Flush quest + permanent Max Stamina boost.

strangers_freaks.name: Freddie
strangers_freaks.reward: Completes the exact 8 eligible chains for the S&F trophy.

secrets_highlights.name: 2002 Vice City PS2 Portal
secrets_highlights.location: Badger R&D Tower → 12 LPL Substations → Turtle Head Reactor 2 (19:00–06:00)
secrets_highlights.reward: Tommy Vercetti Hawaiian Shirt (Jason & Lucia) + Classic Bike (Jason-only, zero fast travel!)

secrets_highlights.name: UFO Abduction + Grassrivers Alien Lab
secrets_highlights.location: NW of Starlet Motel (2 AM, solo) → Fenced South Grassrivers Complex
secrets_highlights.reward: 'The Truth Is Out There' trophy + PERMANENT Health, Stamina & Focus buff

secrets_highlights.name: Mario & Luigi Caps (J & L)
secrets_highlights.location: Stone ruins south of Moreau (North of Mount Kalaga)
secrets_highlights.reward: Hit the bong on the purple tarp to reveal the invisible '?' block & drop both caps

secrets_highlights.name: Arthur Morgan's Hat (RDR2)
secrets_highlights.location: Balloon-marked yard sale on Orchard Ave (south of Moses' Garage)
secrets_highlights.reward: Genuine Cowboy Hat for $35 sitting on a guitar case

secrets_highlights.name: Paul Walker's Green Eclipse
secrets_highlights.location: Mansion garage on Vespucci Island (bridge from Catalan Island)
secrets_highlights.reward: Unique tuned coupe you can hotwire & register permanently

secrets_highlights.name: Cool Dog (Jet Ski Rescue)
secrets_highlights.location: Swim away from your boat in Gambit Bay (Leonida Keys)
secrets_highlights.reward: Ride to Dog Island + $1,218 wallet + exclusive sunglasses

secrets_highlights.name: Dexter's Apartment & Kill Kit
secrets_highlights.reward: Slice of Life boat at the pier + rooftop toolbox Kill Kit

secrets_highlights.name: Monument of Leonidan Supremacy
secrets_highlights.location: Manifest Canyon, north of Port Gellhorn (SR-73)
secrets_highlights.reward: [ACTIVE MYSTERY] Haptic vibration + Morse beeps (solvable Morse puzzle confirmed in Tenebrae Lux)
